BikeDescriptions.gravel: A fast, forgiving gravel bike for mixed surfaces — wide tyres, relaxed geometry and mounts for everything you need on a long day out. The 45 mm tyres soak up gravel, cobblestones and the odd rough trail without giving up speed on tarmac, while the endurance geometry keeps you comfortable well past the first hour. Hydraulic disc brakes and a 2×11 Shimano GRX groupset give you confident stopping power and enough range for flat coastal rides and the climbs further inland. Rack and fender mounts mean it doubles as a capable day-trip bike whenever you want to go further.
BikeDescriptions.mtb: A hardtail mountain bike built for trails and singletrack: air fork, hydraulic disc brakes and grippy 29" tyres. The front suspension soaks up roots and rock gardens while the stiff aluminium frame keeps pedalling efficient on climbs and fire roads. A 1×12 Shimano Deore drivetrain gives you a wide enough gear range to grind up steep singletrack without ever needing a front derailleur to fuss with. Whether you're new to trail riding or chasing something quick for an afternoon in the hills, it's a forgiving, confidence-inspiring bike that doesn't punish small mistakes.
BikeDescriptions.urban: A women's step-through city bike with an upright riding position, fenders and a rack — perfect for commuting and relaxed rides. The low step-through frame makes getting on and off easy in everyday clothes, and the upright bars keep your back relaxed even on longer rides across town. Seven gears cover gentle hills without fuss, while full fenders and a rear rack mean you can carry groceries or a bag without a second thought. A comfortable saddle rounds it out as an easy, no-drama way to get around the city.
BikeDescriptions.vanmoof: A sleek, minimalist urban electric bike with integrated smart features, automatic electronic gear shifting and anti-theft protection — ideal for fast city commutes. A 250 W mid-drive motor and automatic gear shifting take the effort out of hills and stop-start traffic, so you arrive without breaking a sweat. Integrated LED lights and a boost button for quick getaways from the lights make it a natural fit for weaving through city streets after dark. Built-in GPS tracking and an alarm mean you can lock it up outside a café without worrying, and the minimalist aluminium frame keeps it light enough to carry up a flight of stairs.
BikeDescriptions.diverge: A highly versatile gravel bike equipped with Future Shock handlebar suspension, wide tyre clearance and balanced geometry for smooth gravel paths and tarmac alike. The Future Shock absorbs bumps and chatter through the front end without the weight or complexity of a full suspension fork, keeping your hands fresh over long, rough stretches. Wide tyre clearance lets you run anything from fast-rolling gravel tyres to something knobblier for looser trails, and the balanced endurance geometry keeps you comfortable across mixed terrain. A carbon fork and hydraulic disc brakes round it out with confident handling and reliable stopping power whatever the surface.
BikeDescriptions.marlin: A trail-ready hardtail mountain bike with a lightweight RockShox air fork, 1×10 Shimano drivetrain and hydraulic disc brakes built for rugged off-road paths. The RockShox air fork soaks up roots, rocks and drops while staying light enough to keep climbs efficient. A wide-range 1×10 drivetrain gives you enough gearing for steep singletrack without the extra weight and complexity of a front derailleur. Hydraulic disc brakes deliver confident, consistent stopping power in mud or dust, making it a dependable choice whether you're new to the trails or just want something quick for an afternoon in the hills.
